title: Sasha — Edge capacity & ops sprint notes
content:
Quick brain dump for the next two-week sprint and on-call handoff. Mostly TODOs + short command snippets I keep retyping. Treat as my personal checklist not an official runbook.

CONTEXT/GOAL:
- Reduce tail latency on 8-node edge clusters in EWR and LON during burst windows.
- Move 3 racks from spot to reserved (temp) to handle planned marketing demo traffic week of 2026-03-23.
- Validate NVLink health after last firmware push on rack-7.

TOP ITEMS (priority order)
1) Edge pool rebalance (EWR-edge-pools)
   - Current: 38 GPUs available for inference (gpus=RTX800-32G q8_0 profiles), target baseline 64 for demo week.
   - Quick plan: allocate +26 GPUs from regional reserve (committed) -> create capacity request INFRA-4123 follow-up.
   - Steps: 
     * Open PR to infra autoscaler: bump pool.min=64 pool.max=88 (branch: kai/edge-bump).
     * Manual prewarm: prefix cache warmup for the top-5 busiest models (recommendation: alexa-sim, conv-rewrite, summarizer-v2).
     * Nightly check script: ./tools/check-pool.sh ewr-edge-pool --warn-if-low=64
   - Risks: cost spike if reserved freed up unexpectedly. Add budget alert in CloudBilling.

2) NVLink / firmware validation (rack-7)
   - Symptoms: slightly higher p2p latency observed after 2026-03-02 firmware rollout.
   - Quick triage: run nvlink-smoketest on nodes n7{01..08}. Sample commands:
     * ssh ops@n701 sudo nvlink-smoketest --runs=10 --log /tmp/nvlink.log
     * scp n701:/tmp/nvlink.log . && grep "error|timeout" /tmp/nvlink.log || true
   - If errors > 2 across any node -> escalate to Hardware Eng (Rohit) and open HW ticket with serials.

3) TOR / uplink sanity (LON-edge)
   - Recent flakiness reported in monitoring (spike in interface drops around 03:20 UTC).
   - Immediate checks: check interface counters on top-of-rack switches, compare with pod drain times.
   - Commands: 
     * ssh netops@lon-tor-12 show interfaces counters | egrep "drop|error"
     * kubectl get pods -n edge --field-selector=status.phase=Running -o wide | grep lon-edge
   - If correlated with maintenance windows -> update maintenance notes; if not -> raise ticket to Network (include pcap if possible).

DAILY CHECKLIST (morning)
- [ ] Pool availability: ./tools/pool-status --region ewr --pool ewr-edge-pool (expect >=64)
- [ ] KV-cache warm: check cache-hit rate dashboard (should be > 0.75 on warmup models)
- [ ] Node health: ./tools/node-health --since 01h | grep -v OK (scan for warnings)
- [ ] NVLink smoketest quick run on random node (once per weekday)
- [ ] Confirm no unacked alerts in PagerDuty for edge clusters

HANDOFF BULLETS (for next shift)
- Left a reserve change in progress: autoscaler PR #678 (needs CI merge, then run ./ops/apply-autoscaler ewr-edge-pool).
- If you see >5% tail latency increase for model alexa-sim, switch routing to fallback-model: alexa-sim-small (config in /configs/routing).
- FYI: prewarm task started at 23:00 UTC; expected to finish by 00:20. Check logs: /var/log/prewarm/ewr-prewarm-*.log

NOTES / QUICK REMINDERS
- Follow up with Kai on quota increase request for reserved GPUs in GCP (ticket: GCP-REQ-2231).
- Document the NVLink firmware rollback plan in Confluence before Friday (link above).
- Add test to e2e infer-runner that simulates a 20% drop in node count to validate autoscaler fallback.

SNIPPETS I KEEP REUSING
- Check pool counts (useful alias): rde="gcloud compute instances list --filter=\"labels=ewr-edge\" --format=json | jq '. | length'"
- Drain node quickly: kubectl cordon NODE && kubectl drain NODE --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
- Quick metric pull: curl -s "http://metrics.internal/edge/ewr/pool" | jq '.tokens_in_flight, .available_gpus'

OPEN QUESTIONS / TODOs (personal)
- Can we reduce model kv-cache TTL from 12h -> 6h for non-demo models to free memory? Pros/cons? (ask ML infra)
- What triggers the autoscaler to prefer spot GPUs? check autoscaler decision logs (investigate decider component).
- Confirm whether we should treat LON TOR interface flaps as infra-priority or network-priority incidents (ping Rohit).

BRIEF RETROSPECTIVE (notes for end of sprint)
- Success metric: keep 95th percentile token latency below 220ms during demo hour. If not met, next action = increase reserved GPUs by +12 and enable model quantization q4_0 for heavy models.
- Keep an eye on billing alerts: mark any >15% daily spend variance as actionable.

END-OF-DAY LOG (to edit each day)
- 2026-03-09: bumped pool.min -> 64, prewarm ok, NVLink smoketest: n703 showed 3 timeouts -> opened HW ticket (HW-209).
- 2026-03-10: kicked autoscaler PR to CI, found flaky test; need to rebase on main.

Random note to self: remember to add keyboard shortcut for the ./tools/check-pool script in my shellrc. Saves 7 clicks/day.

-- Sasha
